_note: Everything a member changes lives here. keep = SOURCE seconds in your take (the numbers below are example values from the demo take: Claude sets them per take at real pauses). Every other moment is a spoken phrase, matched in assets/words-cut.json, so the look re-times itself to a new take. Run cut.py, then build.py.
_word_fixes_note: Words whisper mishears in YOUR take, lower-case key -> how it should read, e.g. {"kanva": "Canva"}.
_hook_note: The pill hook (3-5 words, a question works well) and an optional small typed line under it. until = the spoken word where the hook leaves (usually your first big word).
_big_words_note: Optional. 1-2 giant words that slam in BEHIND your head on the words you say. at = the spoken word for each line; until = the word where they leave. Behind-the-head needs assets/cutout.webm (see SPEC.md); without it they sit over the footage. Delete this block if you don't want them.
_proof_note: Proof = YOUR OWN screenshots only (a real result, a real message, a real dashboard). Never mock one up. image lives in assets/cards/. label = optional short line in the chip (e.g. 'Client result'). stat = optional number to circle, exactly as it appears in your screenshot (stat_small = optional small word after it). from = the phrase where the card comes in; until = the phrase where it leaves. A card whose image isn't there is skipped.
_chapters_note: Optional numbered chapter stamps. from / until = spoken phrases.
_punches_note: Optional hard camera punch-ins on big lines (never slow pushes): at / until = spoken phrases (until can be END), scale 1.08-1.15.
_keywords_note: Words that get a slightly bigger highlight when they're said.
